You will learn&mdash;or you will fail.|The drill instructor instructs Davin Felth|<ref name="When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''drill instructor''' was a member of the instruction staff at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] basic training facility at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] approximately six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You sand slime have two minutes to change into your physical training gear and get out here with the rest of your squad&mdash;or your butt is mine. Now move!|The drill instructor|<ref name="When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale" />}}
During [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] recruit [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth's]] first day at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], this drill instructor entered the barracks of Felth and fellow recruits [[Mychael Ologat]] and [[Geoff f'Tuhns]], only to discover an open bag of contraband food, which belonged to f'Tuhns. When Felth, covering for his comrade, claimed the bag belonged to him, the drill instructor let Felth go with a warning rather than issuing punishment since it was his first day.
